screens_reviewed: Two scroll captures (07-execute.png top, 08-execute-detail.png slightly scrolled) of app/(tabs)/execute.tsx in dark theme, showing the submitted 'Maple Library Plaza' place: ONLINE StatusBanner, header Card with SUBMITTED badge, a 3-up metric row (Audits/Pending/Score), a 'Report available' card, and a fixed bottom CTA row (Start survey / Open report) above the tab bar.
verdict: A clean, well-composed execute screen that correctly leans on the shared primitives (StatusBanner, Card, ScreenHeader, Badge, MetricCard, AppButton) with no inline re-styling of those components — the route file passes only tokens and layout props. The main real issue is the fixed bottom CTA bar using a hardcoded bottom:16 with no safe-area inset, which is a thin-margin risk on home-indicator iPhones; everything else is solid with minor polish opportunities.

improvements.suggestion: The floating CTA row is positioned with a hardcoded bottom: 16 and does not add useSafeAreaInsets().bottom. It sits above the system tab bar (which does add insets.bottom in (tabs)/_layout.tsx via getResponsiveTabBarLayout), so it is not clipped, but on home-indicator devices the gap to the tab bar / indicator is fixed rather than inset-aware. Read insets via react-native-safe-area-context and set bottom={Math.max(16, insets.bottom)} (or position relative to the tab bar height) so the buttons keep a consistent clearance across notched and non-notched phones. Pair this with raising bottomPadding (currently 92, execute.tsx:123) if the inset grows.
improvements.evidence: execute.tsx:184-192 hardcodes bottom: 16; Provider.tsx and (tabs)/_layout.tsx both consume useSafeAreaInsets, so the inset value is available here too.

improvements.location: app/(tabs)/execute.tsx:153-160 (XStack gap="$3" flexWrap="wrap" with three MetricCard flex={1})
improvements.suggestion: Three MetricCards each flex={1} share a single phone row and fit comfortably at default scale (visible in both captures). With flexWrap="wrap" and a large accessibility fontScale, a card could wrap to its own full-width row and create an uneven 2+1 layout, since MetricCard has no minWidth. Acceptable as-is, but consider a minWidth or an explicit responsive columns count so the grid degrades to a clean 1-per-row rather than 2+1 at the largest text sizes.
improvements.evidence: execute.tsx:153 flexWrap="wrap"; MetricCard.tsx:2167 uses flex={1} with no minWidth; ScaledText multiplies fontSize by fontScale (ScaledText.tsx:2285-2287).

improvements.suggestion: For a submitted place the lower card shows the title 'Report available' but keeps the CloudOff (cloud-off) icon used for the offline-capture state. The icon semantically reads as 'no connection / offline' next to a 'report is ready' message while the banner above says ONLINE. Swap to a report/file icon (e.g. FileText or CheckCircle2 from components/icons) when isSubmitted is true to match the copy.
improvements.evidence: execute.tsx:164 renders CloudOff unconditionally; line 170 switches the text to 'Report available' when isSubmitted; icons.tsx:280 maps CloudOff to feather 'cloud-off'.

tamagui_notes: No inline re-styling of shared primitives: the route uses StatusBanner, Card, ScreenHeader, Badge, MetricCard, AppButton and ScaledParagraph as-is, passing only token-driven props (execute.tsx:126-181), which matches design_system_components_used.

Spacing uses Tamagui space tokens consistently (gap="$3", gap="$1", items/px="$2.5") rather than raw numbers, except the absolute CTA bar which uses raw left/right=layout.screenPaddingHorizontal and bottom:16 — intentional since those need the responsive horizontal value, not a token (execute.tsx:187-191).

The header card body text color is set via style={{ color: tone.text }} on a ScaledParagraph (execute.tsx:139-141); tone.text comes from getPlaceStatusTone with the live dark palette, so it stays theme-correct.
bottomPadding: 92 (execute.tsx:123) is a reasonable manual reserve for the 52pt AppButton row plus its 16pt bottom offset; if the CTA gains a safe-area inset this constant should track it.
platform_notes: Top safe area is handled upstream, not in this route: the screen passes no topInset/includeTopPadding to getResponsiveContentContainerStyle, relying on ScrollView contentInsetAdjustmentBehavior="automatic" plus the root Stack contentStyle paddingTop:20 (app/_layout.tsx:1376-1379). In both captures the ONLINE banner clears the Dynamic Island, so this reads fine on iPhone.

Thumb reach: the two primary CTAs are pinned to the bottom of the screen spanning full width (execute.tsx:184-222), which is good one-handed reach; the destructive/primary 'Open report' is on the right (dominant-thumb side).
Both AppButtons are 52pt tall (AppButton.tsx:1691), clearing the 44pt iOS minimum tap target.
The empty-state branch (execute.tsx:85-95) uses px="$4" py="$6" with no safe-area inset and is not exercised by these screenshots, so its notch clearance is not assessable here.
not_assessable: Offline / pending-sync visual states (StatusBanner warning tone, 'Resume audit' draft CTA) — only the online/submitted state is captured.
Empty-state screen (no place selected) — not shown in either capture.
Exact contrast ratios; the dark palette pairs (mutedForeground #A7A99F on surface #1E201C, success #7FBFA3 accent text) appear comfortably above AA but are estimated, not measured.
Behavior of the Alert offline-readiness modal triggered from openAuditForPlace (execute.tsx:227-230).
score_rationale: Solid, ships with minor polish: faithful use of the shared design system with no token or primitive violations, correct typography/spacing, and adequate tap targets and thumb reach. Held below 9 by the bottom CTA bar's hardcoded bottom:16 that ignores the bottom safe-area inset (a real but non-clipping margin risk on home-indicator iPhones) and the semantically mismatched CloudOff icon on the 'Report available' card.
